Untrusted content: email_verify, pbx_calls_graph, pbx_dictionary, pbx_dictionary_add, pbx_facts, pbx_ingest_transcript, pbx_promises_close, pbx_promises_reopen, pbx_redact_audit, pbx_webhooks, pbx_webhooks_deliveries, pbx_whisper_suggest, tr_tebligat_clock · Private data: iban_validate, pbx_events, pbx_promises_act, pbx_register, pbx_webhooks, pbx_webhooks_deliveries, tr_invoice_build, tr_invoice_parse · Public sink: email_verify, pbx_audio_chunk, pbx_dictionary, pbx_dictionary_add, pbx_index_partial, pbx_ingest_transcript, pbx_promises_act, pbx_promises_close, pbx_promises_reopen, pbx_redact_audit, pbx_register, pbx_webhooks, pbx_webhooks_deliveries, pbx_whisper_suggest, phone_validate, tr_invoice_build, tr_qr_odeme, tr_tebligat_clock · Destructive: pbx_promises_export, pbx_redact, tr_qr_odeme.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: email_verify, pbx_calls_graph, pbx_dictionary, pbx_dictionary_add, pbx_facts, pbx_ingest_transcript, pbx_promises_close, pbx_promises_reopen, pbx_redact_audit, pbx_webhooks, pbx_webhooks_deliveries, pbx_whisper_suggest, tr_tebligat_clock · Private data: iban_validate, pbx_events, pbx_promises_act, pbx_register, pbx_webhooks, pbx_webhooks_deliveries, tr_invoice_build, tr_invoice_parse · Public sink: email_verify, pbx_audio_chunk, pbx_dictionary, pbx_dictionary_add, pbx_index_partial, pbx_ingest_transcript, pbx_promises_act, pbx_promises_close, pbx_promises_reopen, pbx_redact_audit, pbx_register, pbx_webhooks, pbx_webhooks_deliveries, pbx_whisper_suggest, phone_validate, tr_invoice_build, tr_qr_odeme, tr_tebligat_clock · Destructive: pbx_promises_export, pbx_redact, tr_qr_odeme
